narration_timeline.text: From this distant nest camera, we can glimpse bald eagles sharing a place to raise young.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic distant USFWS bald eagle nest; no small-bite claim

narration_timeline.text: Another recording shows adult eagles together in a separate area of their territory.
At a second nest, the family is filmed again from a different viewpoint.
narration_timeline.scene: Second genuine distant USFWS eagle nest

narration_timeline.text: Far from the nest, adults perch, turn, and explore the landscape around them.
Refuge footage reveals another view of these powerful birds in the wild.
narration_timeline.scene: Public domain USFWS eagle footage; no chase claim

narration_timeline.text: Young eagles still rely on adults before they can find food independently.
narration_timeline.scene: Real immature and adult bald eagle scenes
